candidates.buyer: Owners/operators of ferias ganaderas (recintos feriales), small and often family or association run. Number of ferias in Chile not found.
candidates.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
candidates.evidence: Full text read from the Diario Oficial PDF: https://www.diariooficial.interior.gob.cl/publicaciones/2026/03/26/44410/01/2782619.pdf . Amendment of 29 Jul 2026: https://www.diariooficial.interior.gob.cl/publicaciones/2026/07/29/44511/01/2843479.pdf (seen in search results and not read in full; summarised via search). Enforcement context: SAG draft decree replacing the 1983 fairs regulation (May 2026 draft: https://www.sag.cl/sites/default/files/BORRADOR-DECRETO-FERIAS-2026--mayo-2026-observaciones-afech_final.pdf). The 2019 predecessor Res. 7.782 gave 1 year to install RFID reading.
candidates.existing: Only the free official SIPEC module and SAG's 2016 'Titular Movimientos Ferias' manual. The targeted Spanish competitor search ('software feria ganadera remate recinto ferial Chile SIPEC') found no Chilean auction/feria software; only Ecuadorian academic projects. RFID reader hardware vendors not checked.
candidates.known_note: Same livestock-movement family as K08 (horse paperwork) but a different buyer group and a different duty.
candidates.name: Livestock-fair (recinto ferial) traceability and RFID desk: SIPEC movement upload, FMA matching, DIIO capture
candidates.trigger: SAG Res. Ex. 1.884/2026 (DO 26 Mar 2026), amended by Res. 6.589/2026 (DO 29 Jul 2026). Ferias may not receive or auction animals without the FMA. They must load entry and exit movements into the SIPEC Modulo Movimiento en Recintos Feriales within 3 business days of the auction, and carry-over animals by the day before the next auction. Bovines without an RFID DIIO cannot be received or sold. Ferias must have an electronic DIIO reading system and capture DIIO numbers electronically through the whole intake/exit flow. Paper FMAs go to the SAG office within 72 business hours. Ferias may print outgoing FMAs from their own systems if they meet the spec. Sanctions under the DFL RRA 16/1963 and Ley 18.755 and 19.162.
candidates.unchecked: Number and ownership of ferias; whether SAG gives free upload templates or RFID reader integration; transition period after the July 2026 amendment; whether big ferias (e.g. cooperative-run or Fegosa-type firms) already have in-house software; willingness to pay; whether a hardware-plus-software bundle is the real need.

candidates.buyer: Agro-veterinary stores and other registered veterinary-medicine outlets (and vet clinics that dispense) selling products on 'receta retenida con control de saldo'.
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.evidence: https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?i=1010909 (regulation text seen via search summary; not fetched in full). SAG register index fetched: https://www.sag.gob.cl/ambitos-de-accion/como-se-define-un-medicamento-de-uso-veterinario/registros (shows the lists and dates; no text on monthly reporting). https://colegiofarmaceutico.cl/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/QF_Veterinarios-720.doc
candidates.existing: Competitor search ('software clínica veterinaria Chile receta retenida control de saldo SAG informe mensual agroveterinaria sistema') found Veti.app, AgendaPro vet, PetRecord Vet Pro, QVET (Spain). None is documented as producing the balance-control book or the SAG monthly report. Not verified with demos.
candidates.name: Veterinary-medicine sellers' retained-prescription balance book and monthly SAG report
candidates.trigger: SAG veterinary-medicine regulation as hosted on BCN: sell only against a retained prescription; keep the retained-prescription file with balance control plus dispatch notes signed by the Director Tecnico; send the monthly register of entries, exits and balance to the SAG Registro y Control de Medicamentos Veterinarios in the first 10 business days of each month. SAG Res. Ex. 667/2010 sets the retained-prescription requirements (prescription handwritten by the vet per the 2014 College of Pharmacists text; whether digital prescriptions are now valid is unchecked). SAG lists of retained-prescription products updated 09/07/2025, 14/04/2026 and 07/09/2026. A registry of establishments authorised to sell ketamine is updated 23/09/2026.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the monthly report is still required and in what format (the SAG normative tab was not read); how many establishments are registered; whether ERPs used by agro-vet chains already do it; legal validity of electronic prescriptions; whether the reporting goes through an online SAG system.

candidates.buyer: Small and medium chatarrerias and scrap buyers in Chile, many informal or family-run.
candidates.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
candidates.evidence: SII resolution read: https://www.sii.cl/normativa_legislacion/resoluciones/2016/reso86.pdf . https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/05/pdi-incauta-5-toneladas-cobre-robo-atacama-copiapo . https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/01/aduanas-incauta-chatarra-cobre-ilegal-puerto-arica-destino-corea-del-sur . https://www.mch.cl/el-millonario-negocio-de-la-chatarra-de-cobre-en-la-mira-del-sii/ . There is no national scrap-dealer register (the 2007 bill 4804-08 is archived; boletin 14.983-07 on forged copper documents pending).
candidates.existing: Competitor search ('software chatarrería Chile compra de chatarra factura de compra SII control proveedores sistema gestión') found no scrap-specific software in Chile; only SII resolutions and Codelco tenders.
candidates.name: Scrap-yard compliance pack: IVA withholding-agent status, origin documentation and supplier checks
candidates.trigger: SII Res. Ex. 86/2016 (total change of IVA taxpayer on scrap sales): companies that buy or sell scrap and are not exporters/manufacturers become withholding agents once monthly purchases or sales exceed CLP 20m net, or purchases reach CLP 150m net in 12 months. Withholding agents are listed in a public SII nomina and file the annex declarations. Enforcement is rising: PDI seized over 5 t of copper cable in Copiapo in May 2026 from a yard with no municipal permit, no start-of-activities and no origin documents (receptacion plus Ley REP offences); customs stopped suspected stolen copper scrap in Arica in Jan 2026; unions say only about 10% of yards are inspected.
candidates.unchecked: Rest of the SII resolution (annex forms, nomina rules, deadlines); number of yards over the thresholds; whether a mandatory registry bill advances in 2026-27; whether buyers will pay, since many yards are informal; legal risk of serving yards that launder stolen copper.

candidates.buyer: Pesticide distributors, retail agro-input shops, formulators and importers selling to farmers.

candidates.name: Semi-annual pesticide sales declaration filer (SAG Res. 942/2025)
candidates.trigger: SAG Res. Ex. 942/2025 (DO 19 Feb 2025): declare sales to final users in January and July, by SAG authorisation number and monthly quantities (kg/l); error-ridden files are rejected and must be fixed in 5 business days; sanctioned under Ley 18.755 and DL 3.557. Fertilisers, biostimulants and ISP-authorised pesticides are excluded.
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search was not run (budget); number of small retailers; whether SAG gives a template that makes this trivial; agronomic prescription and applicator duties.

candidates.name: Beekeeper annual apiary declaration (FRADA, October) and hive-movement control under Ley 21.489
candidates.trigger: Res. Ex. 8196/2015: annual declaration of apiaries in SIPEC each October, plus updates when an apiary is added or removed. Today (9 Oct 2026) the October window is open.
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search not run (budget); size of the registered beekeeper base; willingness to pay; whether the trashumancia regulation was finalised.

candidates.name: School-van operator document and RENASTRE compliance tracker
candidates.trigger: RENASTRE registration of services, vehicles and drivers with the Subtrans/Seremitt (online with ClaveUnica); driver add/remove/modify filings; the MTT stepped up school-van inspections in 2026 (659 inspected, 49 fined, 3 pulled from service). candidates.unchecked: Recurring deadlines (revision tecnica, insurance, driver licences) not pinned down; low willingness to pay among single-van owners; the school as a buyer; parent apps are generic.

candidates.existing: Competitor search ('software gestión cementerio Chile sepulturas nichos registro traslados sistema municipal parroquial') found no Chilean vendor; only Chronicle (listed on Capterra Chile), CemeteryFind, CIMS and Spanish municipal software.

candidates.trigger: Reglamento General de Cementerios (DS 357/1970) and Codigo Sanitario art. 136. candidates.unchecked: Whether the regulation prescribes specific registers and formats; number of cemeteries; whether municipalities already run the main ones in-house; no recurring filing to an authority was found, only inspection exposure.

candidates.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
candidates.existing: Not searched (budget). Payroll SaaS such as Buk and Talana (known from K10) cover payroll but probably not the guarantee.
candidates.known_note: Adjacent to K02 and K10 but a different duty, and likely too small a niche.
candidates.name: EST (temporary-staffing firm) register and guarantee-renewal tracker
candidates.trigger: Codigo del Trabajo arts. 183-J to 183-M: a register with the DT and a permanent 250 UF guarantee (more above 100/150/200 workers) adjusted every 12 months by worker count, with a minimum 120-day bond. DT dictamen 453/2023: only on-demand bonds or equivalent instruments are accepted.
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search not run; number of ESTs; the sector is probably dominated by mid-sized firms.

candidates.name: Foundation and non-profit compliance tracker if the new public register and sanctions regime passes (Boletin 17.817-07)
candidates.trigger: Pending bill 'Moderniza el regimen normativo de las Corporaciones y Fundaciones y fortalece su fiscalizacion': a new public register, an administrative sanctions procedure including personal liability of directors, tighter controls after the 'caso convenios' (177 foundations, CLP 11bn subject to accounting, over CLP 6.5bn without accredited rendicion). coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: DT contract registration within 15 days of start, contributions due by the 10th (13th if paid electronically); Previred offers contract templates and an existing payment channel. Nothing new beyond a weak, crowded idea (candidate C10). Unchecked: Previred's free household-employer portal features and any 2026 pension-reform changes.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No national scrap-dealer register exists (BCN-type registry bill 4804-08 archived; copper-theft bills pending). Real duty is SII Res. Ex. 86/2016 IVA withholding-agent regime with confirmed thresholds, plus PDI raid in Copiapo in May 2026 on a scrapyard with no origin paperwork. Candidate C3.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No Chile-specific pawnshop/compraventa register found; results were other countries. UAF sujetos obligados list not confirmed to include pawnshops. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No Chile-specific gold-buyer register or UAF duty confirmed. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No dismantler-specific register or ledger in Chile; only the Ley de Transito art. 39 / DS 1111 owner duty to report dismantling to the Registro Civil, and a non-binding 2022 Chamber resolution asking for tougher oversight. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: SAG Res. Ex. 1.884/2026 (DO 26 Mar 2026), modified by Res. 6.589/2026 (DO 29 Jul 2026), imposes strict traceability and electronic RFID reading on recintos feriales. Candidate C1.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Ley 19.162 and DS 342/1993 govern abattoirs and butchers; a Universidad de Chile study covered 95 second-category abattoirs and 45 self-consumption slaughter centres. No recurring filing or 2024-2026 rule found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Annual October FRADA apiary declaration in SIPEC (Res. 8196/2015) and the Ley 21.489 hive-movement control; avisaje pesticide notices already known as K06. Candidate C5, related to K06.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Retained-prescription products with stock-balance control: the seller keeps a retained-prescription file and balance, and reports monthly to SAG (per BCN-hosted regulation text; not fetched in full). SAG lists were updated in 2025-2026. Candidate C2.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: The DGA search returned only other countries' results. Nothing new beyond K07. Chile-specific driller register not verified.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: SIDREP duty falls on the hazardous-waste generator (threshold 12 kg acute-toxic or 12 t other per year), not the hauler; SINADER is annual and its monthly duty is only for municipalities. No hauler-specific recurring filing found. Candidate C15 (weak).

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifts: Ley 20.296 and DS 22/2009 require monthly maintenance by a Minvu-registered firm and certification every 1-2 years. Boilers and autoclaves: Seremi de Salud register, inspection every 3 years. Owners are mostly condominiums (K12 rejected) and larger sites. Candidate C11 (weak).

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent, because K14 (SSR management, rejected) and K07 already cover the area. Budget used on other categories.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: SAG Res. Ex. 942/2025 (DO 19 Feb 2025): semi-annual sales declaration in January and July by distributors, retailers, formulators and importers. Candidate C4. Applicator and agronomic-prescription duties not found.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: EST register at the Direccion del Trabajo with a permanent 250 UF guarantee that adjusts every 12 months by worker count (Codigo del Trabajo arts. 183-J to 183-M; DT dictamen 453/2023 on the form of guarantee). Candidate C8.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: CIPER (April 2025): 14 sanitary fines on 11 cemeteries since 2024, with missing transfer/exhumation records among the faults; DS 357/1970 is the governing regulation. Candidate C7.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Ley 20.500 registry (Registro Civil, municipal secretariats since 2023). Bill Boletin 17.817-07 would create a new public register and sanctions regime after the 'caso convenios'; still pending as of mid-2026. Candidate C9. Halal/kosher not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: RENASTRE: 23,096 registered school-transport vehicles; MTT inspected 659 school vans in 2026 and fined 49. Colectivo operators use the RNSTP and the 'Renueva tu Colectivo' programme. Candidate C6.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Ferias libres run on a municipal permit and an ordinance; no recurring filing found. Currency-exchange houses: CMF/UAF supervision not confirmed in the search results. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo studios: DS 304/2002, with a client-ID register according to Seremi RM. Driving schools: class B programme approval at the Seremitt plus a municipal permit, no recurring report found. Nurseries: Ley de modernizacion de educacion parvularia and registry, status unconfirmed. Hunting outfitters and small food producers not searched. Candidates C12, C13 and C14, all weak.

candidates.existing: Competitor search 'software gestión ELEAM hogar de ancianos Chile ficha residentes fiscalización Seremi sistema' found no ELEAM-specific product and no official resident-file system; the Dipres document only recommends digital registers.
candidates.name: ELEAM authorisation and inspection-readiness desk for elder-care homes
candidates.trigger: DS 20/2021 (in force 30 Sep 2022): sanitary authorisation from the Seremi, Seremi and Senama inspection. Pitrufquen ELEAM fire in Sep 2026 triggered a government inspection push and a Senate committee review. Some homes receive state subsidies.
candidates.unchecked: Exact recurring filings to Seremi or Senama; what a Seremi inspection checks; whether a new bill from the Sep 2026 crisis adds a duty; buyer count and willingness to pay (many homes are small and cash-poor); competing care-home management apps under other names; whether the subsidy-linked reporting is a recurring duty.

candidates.buyer: Small licence holders: botillerias, bars, restaurants, social clubs, and owners who lease a patente
candidates.category: 32. Alcohol-licence holders (Ley 19.925 municipal patentes)
candidates.evidence: Constitucion renewal requirements: https://www.constitucion.cl/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/requerimientos-renovacion-patente_de_alcoholes.pdf ; Chillan form: https://www.municipalidadchillan.cl/sitio/descargas/docs/formularios-renovacion-patentes-alcoholes.pdf ; ChileAtiende renewal report: https://www.chileatiende.gob.cl/fichas/349 ; bill on binding junta de vecinos opinion: https://www.diarioconstitucional.cl/2025/09/08/proyecto-de-ley-otorga-caracter-vinculante-a-opinion-de-juntas-de-vecinos-para-otorgamiento-renovacion-o-traslado-de-patentes-de-alcoholes/

candidates.name: Semester alcohol-patente renewal tracker for bars, botillerias and restaurants
candidates.trigger: Ley 19.925: renewal every six months. Each comuna sets its own deadline and document set. Municipal deadlines can fall as early as late October for the January period. Missing the deadline means losing the patente.
candidates.unchecked: Number of patentes nationwide; whether municipalities already run online renewal; the fee that buyers pay existing gestores; per-comuna variation (about 345 comunas) making a single product hard; Simplo pricing; value above a simple calendar reminder.

candidates.buyer: Small wine, chicha and must producers and bulk wine holders

candidates.existing: Competitor search 'software bodega vinos declaración de cosecha existencias SAG viñateros pequeños libro de bodega' found no software; only the SAG online forms.
candidates.name: Small winery and viñatero SAG declarations pack (harvest, stock, catastro, libro de bodega)
candidates.trigger: Ley 18.455 and SAG Res. 41: annual harvest declaration (1-30 June per ChileAtiende, May 2026; earlier May), stock declaration at 31 Dec due 19 Jan (older SAG Biobio doc), catastro vitivinicola for vineyards of 5,000 m2 or more, libro de existencias visado by SAG with numbered vessels.
candidates.unchecked: Number of small producers who file; whether large winery ERP or winemaking apps already include SAG declarations; the dates (June vs May, and 19 Jan) must be confirmed on sag.gob.cl; offline reach and willingness to pay among tiny family producers.

candidates.buyer: Property brokers, small inmobiliarias and notaries registered with the UAF
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
candidates.evidence: Circular 62: https://guerrero.cl/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DOC_Circular-N°62-UAF.pdf ; DLA Piper: https://www.dlapiper.com/es-ar/insights/publications/2025/03/chile-financial-analysis-unit ; DF on sanctions: https://www.df.cl/empresas/banca-instituciones-financieras/uaf-inicio-80-procesos-sancionatorios-por-incumplir-normas-anti-lavado ; bill: https://www.diarioconstitucional.cl/2026/05/19/iniciativa-legal-busca-regular-el-corretaje-de-propiedades-y-exige-licencia-para-ejercer-la-actividad/
candidates.existing: Competitor search 'software cumplimiento UAF corredores de propiedades inmobiliarias oficial de cumplimiento ROS Chile plataforma' found no broker-specific Chilean platform; only Simplo explainers. The UAF portal itself is free but does not log analysis or KYC.
candidates.name: UAF anti-money-laundering kit for property brokers, notaries and small real-estate firms
candidates.trigger: Ley 19.913 and UAF Circular 62 (Mar 2025): compliance officer, ROS via the UAF Portal de Entidades Reportantes, analysis log, beneficial-owner identification, staff training, registration update within 10 business days. Brokers, notaries and inmobiliarias accounted for 55% of UAF fines in 2018 (Diario Estrategia). A broker licensing bill (Boletin 18.241-03, May 2026 Senate bill) would add more duties.
candidates.unchecked: Number of registered brokers; whether broker CRMs (e.g. portal-linked) bundle UAF modules; AML compliance vendors serving larger firms; the two broker bills' status; willingness to pay by small brokers; a possible overlap with larger vendors for notaries.

candidates.unchecked: Whether the threshold leaves most small clinics out of SIDREP; what the Seremi asks to see each year; waste haulers' own portals; vet applicability.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: 3 searches. No new recurring filing for small station owners found. Related signals: SEC-authorised verification of dispenser volume accuracy (DO Feb 2026, NCh 1436), SEC registry decree (DO Sept 2025), price reporting to CNE. GLP bill Boletin 16035-03 (cylinder traceability, public registers of wholesale and retail distributors, SEC monitoring platform) was still in the Camara Economia committee in April 2024; no later status found. Listed as unverified/weak.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Thin screen. Chile has no coffee or cocoa trade. Only the wine and grape commodity was searched (moved to cat 31). Grain traders and millers were not searched specifically.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: RAE 1321 in force 1 Jan 2026 (published DO 30 Sep 2025, under Ley 21.582 desnotarizacion): notarial requirement removed for general-meeting and board minutes, and advanced e-signature added for some CAC documents. About 1,800 active cooperatives per DAES. One weak candidate (DAES compliance pack). CAC with equity at or above 400,000 UF go to CMF.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Supersalud registry covers individual providers (DS 16/2007). Accreditation of institutional providers is voluntary. No small-clinic periodic filing found. REAS/SIDREP waste duty is the only recurring angle, listed under cat 34.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Libro de control for estupefacientes and psicotropicos (DS 404 and DS 405 art. 18, visado by ISP or health service). DS 405 was amended DO 4 Jun 2025 (content not seen). The electronic-prescription bill, which would require electronic dispensing in every pharmacy, went from the Senate Health committee to Hacienda around 10 Sep 2026. Precursor users were not searched. One unverified candidate.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: No search spent here (budget). Already covered by K01, K02, K04 and K10, so nothing new to flag.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers
coverage.found: 1 search. Only MINVU contractor registries (needed to bid on MINVU-funded work) and an OGUC amendment (DO Feb 2026, content not seen). Nothing beyond K09 and K16. Mining and quarry contractors not searched.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: UAF Circular 62 (Mar 2025) consolidates AML instructions: compliance officer, ROS via UAF Portal de Entidades Reportantes, 10 business days to update registration, beneficial owner. Corredores de propiedades, notarios and inmobiliarias are obliged subjects (Ley 19.913). There is no national broker register in force. Bills: Boletin 18.241-03 and a May 2026 Senate bill would add licences and mandatory registers. One candidate.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Sernatur national register is mandatory by law for lodging and adventure tourism (Ley 20.423, DS 19/2018), needs a commercial licence, and Sernatur cannot fine. No guest-register duty to PDI found, and no tourism levy. Weak.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: SAG phytosanitary export certificates are issued through the Multipuerto system. Ley 21.488 and SII Res. 75 (in force Nov 2024) on timber and leña dispatch guides. The Sernapesca artisanal landing declaration is free and online. No small-exporter traceability gap found beyond weak candidates.

coverage.category: 31. Wine, chicha and must producers (SAG Ley 18.455 declarations)
coverage.found: Annual harvest declaration (ChileAtiende, May 2026: 1-30 June; older sources say May), stock declaration at 31 Dec due 19 Jan, catastro vitivinicola for plots of 5,000 m2 or more, and a libro de existencias visado by SAG. No software found for small wineries.

coverage.category: 32. Alcohol-licence holders (Ley 19.925 municipal patentes)
coverage.found: Renewal every six months in every comuna, with no automatic renewal. Documents: junta de vecinos report, Carabineros report, criminal-record certificate, sworn declaration, last paid patente, lease papers if rented. Requirements vary by comuna. Bills would make the junta de vecinos opinion binding (Sep 2025); Contraloria extended the ban on patentes to municipal honorarios staff (Apr 2026, headline only).

coverage.category: 33. Elder-care homes (ELEAM, DS 20/2021)
coverage.found: 947 authorised ELEAM, of which only 22 are public (CIPER May 2025), plus an unknown number of irregular homes. After the Pitrufquen fire in Sep 2026 there are presidential calls for inspection, MINSAL publishes a weekly-updated list of ELEAM with valid sanitary authorisation, and Contraloria is reviewing the Coyhaique Seremi. The Supreme Court upheld a closure for lack of authorisation (rol 58.411-2024).

coverage.category: 34. Health-care and clinical waste generators (REAS DS 6/2009, SIDREP DS 148/2003)
coverage.found: SIDREP declaration is due only above 12 kg of acute-toxic waste or 12 t of other hazardous waste per year, so most small clinics and dental offices are probably below the threshold. REAS DS 6/2009 plan de manejo applies to all care establishments. Registration goes through the RETC Ventanilla Unica. No specific software for small generators found.

coverage.category: 35. Artisanal fishers and caletas (Sernapesca)
coverage.found: The landing declaration needs RPA registration and traceability-system access; it is free online or at Sernapesca with ClaveUnica. No new 2026 duty found.

coverage.category: 36. Forest products, firewood and timber dealers (Ley 21.488)
coverage.found: Ley 21.488 strengthens control of the forest-product supply chain. SII Res. 75 (Nov 2024) updates the electronic dispatch guide and invoice rules for forestry taxpayers. CONAF is becoming SERNAFOR (Aug 2026). Weak.

coverage.category: 37. Corporate crime-prevention models (Ley 21.595 as amended by Ley 21.770, Sep 2025)
coverage.found: Official MPD certification registry removed, replaced by periodic independent assessments. Horizontal and crowded; related to K13 and K17. Listed as weak.
